ebitda_margin.quote: Margin EBITDA for the half was INR54.9 crores, up by 11.9% from INR49.1 crores, at a margin of 21.2% of total income against 25.2% last year.

rev_yoy_pct.quote: Revenue from operations for the half was INR255 crores, up by 33.7% from INR190.7 crores.

pat_yoy_pct.quote: Profit after tax for the half was INR35.7 crores, up by 18.1%.

order_book.detail: Traditional business order book is approximately 3 to 4 months, and OEMs have visibility of approximately 1 to 2 years.
order_book.quote: Like for traditional business the order book is approximately 3 to 4 month and for the OEMs, we have visibility approximately 1 years or 2 years.

capex.detail: Brownfield plant of 50,000 square feet within Unit 1 for contact sensors for OEMs
capex.quote: Also, we are adding a brownfield plant of 50,000 square feet within Unit 1 for contact sensors, for the -- mainly for the OEMs. And this plant remains on track to be completed by Q3 of FY28

capex.detail: Capacity addition of about 25,000 square feet for custom-built large furnaces
capex.quote: We are also adding capacity of about 25,000 square feet for custom-built large furnaces.

capex.detail: New plant of about 50,000 square feet within Unit 6 for mid-voltage heaters
capex.quote: The new plant of about 50,000 square feet within Unit 6 is on track to be completed by Q1 of FY28.

capex.detail: Unit 8 new cable plant
capex.quote: Unit 8, our new cable plant, is on track for completing in Q2 of FY28

capacity.detail: Adding 5 projects commissioning between FY27 Q4 and Q3 of FY28 with aggregated peak revenue potential of INR500 crores at full utilization.
capacity.quote: So we are adding 5 projects which are commissioning between FY27 Q4 and Q3 of FY28, with an aggregated peak revenue potential of about INR500 crores at full utilization.

mix.detail: Currently 95% make-to-order, moving towards blending in about 20% standard OEM products over the next 3 years.
mix.quote: Most of that we do I would say that 95% of what we do is make-to-order as on today.

catalysts.detail: Standard furnaces are ETL and CE approved with bulk supplies starting in Q3.
catalysts.quote: Secondly, these laboratory furnaces are now ETL and CE approved. With bulk dispatches starting from Q3 of this year.

catalysts.detail: Supplies of high temperature wire harness and OEM sensors ramping up in the second half.
catalysts.quote: As supplies of harness cables and furnace starts and the OEM sensors ramp up in the second half, we expect the profitability to improve progressively.

risks.detail: Disruption in Middle East impacting traditional industry orders.
risks.quote: And once this disruption because of political situation in Middle East gets a little bit resolved, we see a huge potential would be there
